sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash official model card
sources.evidence: Names the exact model and nominal 30B-A3B MoE size; declares MIT in model-card metadata; publishes BF16 deployment examples, reasoning and tool-call parsers, and speculative decoding. The linked technical report is for GLM-4.5, not an exact Flash parameter-count specification.

sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM: 47 main layers, first layer dense, hidden size 2048, 64 routed experts with top 4 plus 1 shared expert, one next-token-prediction layer, 20 attention heads, query rank 768 and KV rank 512. Native position limit 202752; BF16 and untied main token embedding/output matrices.

sources.title: BigModel model and product release log
sources.evidence: The January 19, 2026 entry explicitly announces GLM-4.7-Flash and links its exact model guide. This is release evidence, independently of repository creation or provider listing dates.

sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash model guide
sources.evidence: The exact Flash guide specifies text input/output, a rounded 200K context window, thinking modes and function calling. Its examples request glm-4.7-flash with thinking enabled. General interface-generation examples are not evidence of image input.

sources.title: GLM-4.7-Flash tensor index and all 48 bounded shard headers
sources.evidence: All 9703 indexed tensors reconciled exactly once across 48 shard headers at revision 7dd20894a642a0aa287e9827cb1a1f7f91386b67. HTTP 206 byte ranges retrieved only length prefixes and JSON headers, never weight payloads. BF16 tensors contain 31,221,485,568 elements; F32 routing buffers contain 3,008. Main model excluding MTP has 29,943,390,976 BF16 elements. MTP adds 1,278,094,592 stored elements, including 634,388,480 embedding/output elements whose sharing differs across runtimes. These are inventory counts, not an asserted unique full parameter total.

sources.title: Transformers GLM-4 MoE Lite implementation
sources.evidence: Model implementation linked by Z.ai identifies attention as Multi-headed Latent Attention. e_score_correction_bias is an F32 buffer, not a learned parameter. Standard causal inference omits checkpoint layer 47, the separate prediction module.

sources.title: vLLM GLM-4 MoE Lite multi-token predictor
sources.evidence: Officially linked runtime instantiates predictor embedding and output modules and maps the stored layer-47 tensors into them. The inventory therefore includes modules used by this speculative-decoding implementation.

sources.title: SGLang GLM-4 MoE Lite loader
sources.evidence: Officially linked runtime explicitly shares the target model embedding/output for MTP and skips its stored embed_tokens and shared_head.head entries. This prevents treating all stored BF16 elements as a runtime-independent unique parameter count.

sources.title: Z.ai GLM-4.7 series API guide
sources.evidence: Lists GLM-4.7, GLM-4.7-FlashX and GLM-4.7-Flash separately; the Flash entry has text input/output and a rounded 200K context. No FlashX topology is transferred to Flash.

name.note: Exact official release and checkpoint name.

developer.note: Official Z.ai checkpoint and Zhipu AI platform release.

family.note: Retain the normalized Flash grouping for this explicitly named GLM-4.7 variant; the family key does not establish shared weights with older Flash models.

release_date.note: Explicit dated first-party release entry, consistent with the original checkpoint publication.

open_weights.note: Official public BF16 checkpoint and all indexed shard headers are accessible.

license.note: Exact checkpoint card declares MIT; hosted API terms are a separate matter.

parameters_b.note: Author-published nominal 30B total. The complete stored BF16 inventory is 31.221485568B, including MTP embedding/output copies. Runtime sharing differs, so that storage sum is not substituted for a unique full count. The source does not define whether its nominal 30B includes MTP.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-published nominal A3B. An exact activation-count convention, including embedding and MTP treatment, is not disclosed; do not infer one from the stored tensor total.

architecture.note: Decoder-only causal Transformer with MLA: 47 main layers comprise 1 dense and 46 MoE layers. Each MoE layer routes to 4 of 64 experts plus 1 shared expert. One additional MTP layer is stored at layer 47. MLA uses 20 heads, query rank 768 and KV rank 512; this is not the full GLM-4.7 architecture.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint max_position_embeddings; hosted guides advertise rounded 200K. Use the native checkpoint value for this open-weight release, not provider route limits.

modalities.note: Exact Flash entries specify text input and output; code for visual applications does not imply image understanding.

reasoning.note: Exact guide supports thinking modes and model card supplies a reasoning parser and preserved-thinking evaluation instructions.

tool_call.note: Exact guide supports function calling; local deployment examples enable automatic tool selection with the GLM tool parser.

description.value: Open-weight text MoE model with MLA attention, reasoning and tool calling; published as 30B total and 3B active parameters.
description.note: Replace unsupported budget/routing wording with checkpoint characteristics and supported capabilities.

patch.description: Open-weight text MoE model with MLA attention, reasoning and tool calling; published as 30B total and 3B active parameters.
patch.notes: 30B total and 3B active are Z.ai’s nominal labels. The checkpoint includes one MTP layer and stored embedding/output copies; supported runtimes handle sharing differently, so its 31.221485568B BF16 storage-element sum is not treated as an exact unique model size. Native context is 202752 tokens; API documentation rounds this to 200K. These specifications describe GLM-4.7-Flash, not FlashX or the older GLM-4.5-Flash endpoint.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Added MIT, author-nominal 30B total / 3B active, and exact MLA/MoE topology; corrected native context from 200000 to 202752 and replaced the unsupported description. Original January 19 release is primary-source confirmed. All 48 shard headers were reconciled without weight downloads; stored MTP embedding/output duplication prevents promoting their sum to a runtime-independent unique parameter count.
